rule.caliber: cumulative return from STARTING equity of the base anchor (not peak-relative); main-reading NAV series navm; window ends = anchor ends (AMENDMENT 2 §1)
rule.halt_semantics: at the first window end strictly below the threshold the path stops trading and its NAV is held flat; no manual resume is modelled
granularity: utc_day_ends_only (sensitivity, the live watchdog's daily cadence)
rule.note_window_end: breach_by stays 2026-08-31T00:00:00Z (AMENDMENT 2 §2); the 'to_window_end' block runs to 2026-09-18T20:00Z, i.e. through the describe-only extension segment
